#281 round-2 correctness review (C34 final round)
Head: b803bdb332196fb43bdf78a7c9fcc263c70ef1b1
Result: PASS. Both R1 blockers fixed; no additional blocking findings.
Reviewed delta: ed493731a221dc57a17811962203ee07ff925429..d161c5e1,
five files, +114/-7. The merge of main is not re-reviewed.

R281-001:
The global thread-start reason clears the failure map before selection/probing,
so a new thread immediately after the fourth failed attempt gets its own fresh
three-retry budget. Counters remain keyed by SeatId within that budget; bound,
decided and absent rows lose their counters through the existing retain.

R281-002:
The exhaustive is_transient match preserves Runtime and Retryable as probe
errors. Stable Refused, InvalidSeatId, Retired, PaneHeld and PaneHolderChild
remain logged decisions and are not quiet-tick retried. The new FakeRegistry
write-error script records the attempted put but returns before sequence or
roster mutation; its default empty queue preserves existing fake behavior.

Native holds:
NativeHolderCurrent and NativeSessionHold are classified as transient in the
new helper but are unreachable by CodexBinder today. Its register_via call
passes native=None and its claim has an id, choosing RegistrationMode::Ordinary
(registration.rs:536-553). NativeHolderCurrent is emitted from the native entry
at :781 or behind if native at :1359; NativeSessionHold is produced by
check_native_roster, called only behind if native at :1247. The sole production
helper caller is CodexBinder. This changes neither plan 168's precedence/lease
brake nor any native registration handler. A repeated attempt does not waive
any admission, process, pane, retirement or contradictory-claim guard.

Cost and the exact brake scope:
Reset is GLOBAL, not tied to the row's own conversation. Unrelated thread starts
DO refresh every pending row's budget, indefinitely if starts continue. There
is NO seat-lifetime three-retry cap. This is the existing global thread_started
trigger: it already caused every pending row to probe on each start before R2.
The fix grants up to three additional QUIET-tick retries per newly observed
global start, retaining the unchanged one-probe-per-row-per-binder-tick limit.

For N continuously failing pending rows, tick interval I (default 5 seconds),
and lambda observed thread-start ticks per second:
- Additional quiet probes: at most 3 * N * lambda per second.
- Per reason: at most N * (1 initial probe + 3 retries).
- Total probes: at most N / I per second, including start-triggered probes.
Multiple thread starts between ticks coalesce. Under a start on every tick,
all probes are already start-triggered and total is N/5 per second; when starts
stop, at most three quiet retry ticks follow and launches then stop.
Removing the retry cap only adds probes: it remains a one-directional brake,
not the global thread-start policy. No new loop, timer or launch site.
Busy on macOS costs one lsof and no tmux launch. Registration retries pay the
FULL existing attempt (including process/holder reads and store write), not just
the three mocked Facts stages; actual launches are the attempt's existing
launch-site counters. This review does not substitute for live cost receipts.

Proof:
The same two reviewer reproduction bodies that failed on ed49373 now pass:
reviewer_new_thread_resets_an_exhausted_retry_budget_before_a_quiet_tick and
reviewer_a_transient_registration_read_retries_on_the_next_tick. The latter
retains the original single liveness-read failure, independently of the new
committed store-write test. Each healthy subsequent tick now binds once.

All 12 committed Codex binder tests plus these two repros and one rate probe
passed (15/15, exit 0) through:
  PIJ_SHARED_TARGET=/Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/pij/target just shared-build -- test --locked -p pij-daemon --lib codex_bind -- --nocapture
The source was git archive of the exact head, with only three reviewer tests
and their helper added. Production binder code compared byte-for-byte with the
read-only review checkout before running. The source archive is removed after
the test; reviewer-probes.patch and probes.log preserve the evidence.

reviewer_frequent_unrelated_starts_probe_once_per_tick_then_stop passes:
50 successive unrelated global starts cause exactly 50 probes, then 50 quiet
ticks add exactly three probes and stop. 106 mocked Facts stages = 53 probes,
not a real launch count. The stable Refused control passes with one probe over
30 ticks, and the committed transient store-write test retries and binds.

harness checks was actually run at this head: exit 1, six sensors pass, eight
fail, one advisory warns. Rust (fmt, local macOS clippy, all workspace tests),
route inventory, smoke, native contracts, the installed Copilot SDK contract
and pij-skill pass. The remaining sensors lack local TS dependencies/tsx or
select incompatible ambient Biome in this dependency-free review checkout.
No dependencies were linked or installed (C25); exact-head CI is green, verified
by just pr-freeze 281. The local full gate is not represented as green.

The frozen head and clean review checkout are rechecked before publication.
No new R2 mutations or unrelated hardening were required (C34). The original
R1 failing repro receipts and the current green run prove both corrections.

Harness feedback:
The committed immediate-thread reset, transient store-write and stable-refusal
tests encode R1's findings. FakeRegistry::script_put_error is reusable
deterministic write-failure injection rather than another per-test registry.
The cost receipt must distinguish a per-global-start brake from a lifetime cap
and total probes from additional quiet retries.
